title: taiwan-landslide-carbon-ledger: national annual ledger of forest living-biomass carbon lost to and re-accumulated after landslides in Taiwan, 2004–2025 (code, derived tables and figures)
description: Code, derived tables and figures for a national annual ledger of forest living-biomass carbon removed by catalogued landslides in Taiwan and re-accumulated on the scars, 2004–2025, compared with the disturbance-loss term of the national greenhouse gas inventory. The ledger applies the IPCC gain-loss method on a 30 m grid: the event-based landslide catalogue gives the activity data; the stand stock of the fourth national forest inventory, scaled by the measured pre-failure canopy stature of the failing cells (CHMv2 with image dates), gives the stock removed; and canopy-height recovery gives the re-accumulation. Independent checks use the third-inventory photo points, the official annual landslide maps 2017–2024 and GEDI L4A footprints. Includes the data-preparation scripts, the analysis pipeline, the results tables with bootstrap replicates and the figures.
